status: prospectively frozen exploratory analysis plan; not a preregistration or confirmatory analysis
prior_information: The legacy corpus and 12-judgment smoke results were previously explored. This plan is fixed before viewing the new 636-judgment full standard159 results.

scope.eligibility: FunctionalCategory exactly standard; Tags.strip() and ContextString.strip() empty; canonical CSV row-derived BehaviorID binding

integrity.source_of_truth: Rebuild the 636 tasks from the pinned verified input ZIP with the reviewed standard159 runner; archived tasks must match exactly, including ordering and all content.
integrity.binding: Require pinned reviewed runner/parser bytes; runner verify_record and parser; per-record content, task and protocol hashes; canonical BehaviorID/condition/evaluator/seed/response/legacy binding; raw completion parsing and binary-label agreement; protocol model/revision/template/settings/tasks/input/plan/code binding. Fail closed on unexpected records, duplicate keys/files, conflicting content, protocol drift, or label/parser mismatch.
integrity.missing: Default analysis requires all 636 planned records. Explicit --allow-incomplete permits provisional analysis with missing records listed separately and prominent warnings. Missing/nonbinary records are never imputed or classified as safe.
integrity.manifest: Record plan, input, runner, parser, tasks, protocols and analysis-code SHA-256 hashes in the analysis output. Freeze and archive this plan before inference.

outcomes.primary_unit: Within evaluator, pair the FP16 and SP70 judgments by canonical BehaviorID; include only pairs with two valid binary judgments.
outcomes.primary_estimand: Observed SP70 minus FP16 unsafe-label risk difference among complete valid pairs in this fixed 159-behavior saved-response set.

tests: HB: FP16 versus SP70 unsafe binary paired exact two-sided McNemar
LG: FP16 versus SP70 unsafe binary paired exact two-sided McNemar
primary_family.exact_p: If n_valid_pairs>0: min(1, 2*sum(comb(b+c,k), k=0..min(b,c))/2**(b+c)); b+c=0 gives 1. If n_valid_pairs=0, p is null (not estimable).
primary_family.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the fixed two-test HB/LG family; stable evaluator ordering HB then LG breaks ties. For adjustment only, an unestimable test occupies its family slot with p=1; its reported raw and adjusted p remain null.
primary_family.additional_inferential_tests: None. No post-hoc subgroup p-values, alternative tests, or p-values for secondary summaries.

risk_difference_interval.method: Paired nonparametric bootstrap percentile interval on mean(SP70-FP16). Sort complete valid pairs by BehaviorID; independently resample n pair indices with replacement for each replicate.
risk_difference_interval.generation_order: Generate all (20000,n) integer indices in one rng.integers(0,n,size=(20000,n)) call, then average selected signed differences by row.
risk_difference_interval.coverage: Nominal 95% per-evaluator intervals, not multiplicity-adjusted or simultaneous.
risk_difference_interval.zero_pairs: Point estimate and interval are null when n=0. Degenerate intervals for identical differences or n=1 are reported, not widened.

descriptive_outputs.per_evaluator_condition: Planned n=159; records present; judged; safe; unsafe; invalid; abstain; excluded; missing; valid binary denominator; unsafe/valid binary rate (null when valid n=0). Nonbinary/missing counts do not enter that rate denominator.
descriptive_outputs.paired: Complete valid paired n; full 2x2 counts; b/c discordances; SP70-FP16 risk difference; nominal paired-bootstrap 95% interval; exact raw and Holm-adjusted p-values; status-pair counts and unpaired/nonbinary IDs.
descriptive_outputs.legacy: For each evaluator and condition, full transition table from legacy 0/1 to new safe/unsafe/invalid/abstain/excluded/missing, plus binary valid agreement numerator/denominator and rate. Legacy agreement is not accuracy.
descriptive_outputs.cross_evaluator: For each condition, HB-versus-LG same-BehaviorID/same-response status transition table; on mutually valid binary records, disagreement count/denominator/rate and binary 2x2 counts. No p-values.
descriptive_outputs.per_record: All 636 expected task rows, including missing; behavior, condition, evaluator, response hash, legacy and new labels, status, agreement, hashes, and raw completion when present.

interpretation: Exploratory model-judge labels on a fixed benchmark subset and one saved generation seed, not human-validated safety accuracy.
New-versus-legacy agreement is agreement only, not accuracy; judge/protocol changes can cause transitions.
No population-wide generalization, pruning-causal claim, or inference about other generation seeds or excluded contextual/copyright categories.
Complete-valid-pair results are conditional on validity; missing, excluded, abstaining, or invalid judgments may induce selection bias. Report their counts and identities with all primary summaries.
Nominal bootstrap intervals and exploratory p-values do not remove selection limitations or benchmark dependence.
change_policy: Do not alter this plan after new outputs are viewed. Corrections require a separately versioned dated amendment with rationale, original plan retained, and disclosure of whether results were viewed.
